programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, the crew travels to Wyoming for a three-day waterfowl hunt with the Teton Mallard Company. Hunting everything from narrow creeks and sloughs to larger river channels, they adapt to changing weather, shifting winds, and unpredictable bird movement as they pursue ducks against the stunning backdrop of the Teton Range.Throughout the hunt, the team puts Winchester's Last Call Double Shot ammunition to the test, showcasing its stacked payload technology in real hunting conditions. As opportunities come and go, they break down how the combination of plated steel and tungsten delivers increased pellet counts, hard-hitting performance, and confidence on challenging shots.From slow mornings to exciting evening flights, every hunt brings new lessons, memorable retrieves, and the reward of time spent in the blind. Set in one of the West's most scenic waterfowl destinations, this episode highlights the preparation, adaptability, and precision it takes to make the most of every opportunity in the field.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: In this episode of Winchester Life, a special goose hunt in South Dakota becomes a memorable day in the field as Foster heads out with Shadow, his 14-year-old black Lab and longtime hunting partner. With the season bringing challenging conditions and Shadow slowing down with age, the goal is simple: enjoy the hunt and give Shadow one more opportunity to do what he loves.As the geese begin to move, the hunt delivers an unforgettable series of retrieves and a chance to reflect on the countless hunts and memories the two have shared over the years. From Shadow's early days as a hunting dog to becoming a beloved part of the family, his impact reaches far beyond the field.With each retrieve, the day becomes less about the harvest and more about celebrating a hunting partner who has given 14 years of loyalty, determination, and unforgettable memories. As Foster looks toward future hunts without Shadow by his side, one thing remains certain—the memories they made in the field will never be forgotten.

In this premiere episode, Rush Maltz jumps aboard a skiff with local captain Jake Leon to explore the shallow, clear waters that make Key Largo one of the most iconic fisheries in the Florida Keys. From stealthy presentations to explosive eats, this is inshore fishing at its finest. With unmatched access to the Atlantic Ocean, Florida Bay, and Everglades National Park, Key Largo truly lives up to its reputation as the gateway to paradise. From snook and sea trout to elusive bonefish, this episode sets the tone for a season built around world-class fishing, local eats, and unforgettable destinations. Get ready for the first stop of your Florida Keys experience.

He has co-starred in popular films such as Terminator 2: Judgment Day, Planet of the Apes, Lost Treasure and The Pursuit of Happiness. He has been featured on NBC Nightly News, HBO, Showtime, CNN, Glenn Beck, Hannity and Colmes, NPRS Fresh Air, ABC Nightline, MTV, and Comedy Central. He has had material published in Readers Digest and Focus on the Family magazine.He has five original DVDs featuring his comedy, and has written two books, Live from Middle America Rants from a Red-State Comedian, published by Hudson Street Press and Being a Christian Without Being an IdiotHe has appeared in numerous films including Poodle Springs on HBO, Welcome to Paradise, Sarahs Choice, Christmas With a Capital C, and Covering Your Tracts. programme.title: LEGO Marvel Super Heroes: Avengers Reassembled
programme.desc: The Avengers must now fight one of their own, and they're not sure what to do! Cap and Thor lead the charge, but can't fend off Iron Man and Ultron's Minions. Meanwhile, Black Widow, Hawkeye and Hulk track down a signal that seems to be controlling Iron Man from a castle in the “Little Sokovia” section of New York. There they fight HYDRA and BARON VON STRUCKER and learn that YELLOWJACKET is the “bug” that infected Iron Man's suit for Ultron. To help break Iron Man free from Ultron's control, the Avengers call in their own bug...ANT MAN! The Avengers prepare for a party with a surprise guest when Ultron crashes the preparations by using mind control on Iron Man. While trying to rescue their leader, the rest of the team discovers that Baron Stucker, HYDRA, and Yellowjacket are in on Ultron's plans. While preparing for a party at Avengers' Tower, THE AVENGERS (IRON MAN, CAPTAIN AMERICA, BLACK WIDOW, HAWKEYE, THOR, HULK and VISION) notice Iron Man acting strangely. When Iron Man volunteers to go out and get more ice, they find it odd: when has Tony every volunteered to get anything? Suddenly, ULTRON appears on a screen: he's taken control of Iron Man! To make matters worse, Ultron takes over all the versions of Iron Man's armor and they fly off! Finally, the Avengers confront Ultron and his Ultron Minions as they attack Avengers' Tower. Ultron's ultimate plan: use all the data/stuff they've stolen to free the newly rebuilt IRON LEGION, destroy the Avengers, and control the world. Tony dons the hastily repaired Hulk Buster Armor and it's on! It's a huge battle as the Avengers try to save their beloved HQ and defeat Ultron. Will they succeed? And, more importantly, can their party be saved after Ultron tries to take down their Tower?

programme.title: Debieron ahorcarlos antes
programme.desc: Dos sujetos roban el oro del ejército, Silvestre es aprendido, pero el abuelo huye junto a Joe Oaxaca y el federal Tomás Bueno. Se desata un tiroteo del que tendrán que salir bien librados.

programme.title: Morgana
programme.desc: El suicidio de una mujer demente a finales del siglo XIX tiene consecuencias terribles en la época actual. El miedo y el horror se apoderan especialmente de una jovencita en una pesadilla que parece llevarla directamente a su propia muerte.

programme.title: Los desalmados
programme.desc: Dos cazarrecompensas se convierten en fieles y buenos amigos, a pesar de los problemas debido a sus profesiones.

programme.title: Verdugo de traidores
programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.title: Garra de Tigre
programme.desc: Un maestro de artes marciales cría a tres niños para que sean hombres de bien y sepan defenderse de "Garra de Tigre".

programme.title: El mil hijos
programme.desc: El dueño de una cadena de taquerías tiene hijos con distintas mujeres quienes a su vez lo engañan con otros hombres. Él ignora la situación y ellas se aprovechan por la conveniencia de sus negocios. Tras una ida al hospital se descubre la verdad.

programme.title: El Payo: un hombre contra el mundo
programme.desc: El Payo protege a su familia del bajo mundo del crimen, el cual quiere robarle su vida y su integridad.

programme.title: Barridos y regados
programme.desc: Cuando dos mensajeros llegan con un recado a una empresa, los confunden con los técnicos a los que esperaban y ellos aprovechan la situación para ganar dinero e impresionar a las bellas secretarias.

programme.title: Malverde, la leyenda
programme.desc: En el norte de México, un famoso bandolero se gana a la gente al repartir parte del producto de sus robos entre la población.

programme.title: Sor Batalla
programme.desc: Una monja es enviada a un pueblo lejano, gobernado por un hombre malvado, y con su fe y alegría intenta cambiarlo.

programme.title: El tesoro del amazonas
programme.desc: Un aventurero y sus amigos compiten contra un ex-nazi y otras personas que buscan un tesoro de diamantes en la selva sudamericana.

programme.title: Los supersabios
programme.desc: Los supersabios construyen un cohete espacial. Panza Y Pola provocan la curiosidad de los villanos Solomillo y el médico. Los muchachos despegan su nave y se encuentran con Panza y Pola para comenzar a explorar.

programme.title: Ha entrado una mujer
programme.desc: Una mujer que no pudo tener consigo a su hijo de pequeño lo encuentra de joven y lucha para ganar su aprecio.

programme.title: Asesinos comerciantes de niños
programme.desc: Los padres de un niño secuestrado se enfrentan a una banda criminal que trafica con órganos humanos de menores.

programme.title: El Hijo del Otro
programme.desc: Una mujer le habla de su embarazo a su esposo, un hombre estéril. Más tarde él descubre que fue inseminación artificial.

programme.title: Silencio asesino
programme.desc: Una joven rica es secuestrada por unos delincuentes, pero uno de sus captores se convierte en su protector.

programme.title: El Diablo en Persona
programme.desc: Un hombre se enamora de una mujer con serias intenciones matrimoniales y se une a una banda de revolucionarios.

programme.title: Las siete Cucas
programme.desc: Todos los hombres desaparecen tras las puertas de la casa de "Las siete Cucas".

programme.title: Verdugo de traidores
programme.desc: Un comandante de policía tiene que eliminar la corrupción que existe en su departamento a causa de los sobornos.

programme.title: Mágico, el Enviado de los Dioses
programme.desc: Un héroe enmascarado llamado Mágico llega a la Tierra para pelear contra una fuerza maléfica y defender a los necesitados.

programme.title: La Chamuscada
programme.desc: Un peón se une a la revolución y llega a ser coronel de las tropas zapatistas después de huir del maltrato de su patrón.

programme.title: Operación 67
programme.desc: Una banda oriental intenta falsificar las placas con que se imprimen los billetes de un país latino para desestabilizarlo.

programme.title: El Quelite
programme.desc: Un hombre tiene una sensación extraña cada vez que escucha la música de una canción.

programme.title: El tesoro de Moctezuma
programme.desc: Santo y dos agentes enfrentan a unos villanos cuando se tratan de robar el tesoro de Moctezuma.

programme.title: Rosendo Fierro, el correo de Villa
programme.desc: Por tener acceso a cualquier lugar, un herrero es enviado por el general Villa con un mensaje importante para Zapata.

programme.title: Duelo en El Dorado
programme.desc: Poveda, el cacique, se presenta como padre legítimo de un niño y lo rapta. El ex pistolero comienza una intensa lucha con el secuestrador para rescatar al niño.

programme.title: Espejismo de la Ciudad
programme.desc: Una familia campesina vende todas sus posesiones y se muda a la ciudad, donde encuentran grandes dificultades y dolor.

programme.title: Servicio Secreto
programme.desc: Las historias de tres policías que resuelven todos sus casos en forma cómica.

programme.title: Nuestras Vidas
programme.desc: Cuatro años después de su graduación, varios amigos preparatorianos de Londres luchan por alcanzar el éxito.

programme.title: Tres tristes tigres
programme.desc: Tres amigos reciben una cuantiosa herencia por parte de un exprofesor con la condición de dedicarse a educar niños.

programme.title: Y mañana serán mujeres
programme.desc: Una maestra es invitada por los padres de algunas de sus alumnas a pasar las vacaciones de verano en un rancho.

programme.title: Aventuras de Joselito y Pulgarcito
programme.desc: Un niño español se embarca rumbo a México para buscar a su padre y se hace amigo de un niño vendedor de periódicos.

programme.title: Los Gavilanes Negros
programme.desc: Tres enmascarados negros toman la justicia por su propia mano y protegen a un pueblo dominado por un cacique.

programme.title: Esta noche no
programme.desc: Un piloto lleva una doble vida: está casado con dos mujeres y debe mantener los dos hogares. Todo se complica cuando lo descubren.

programme.title: Esposa te doy
programme.desc: Sofía y Alberto, son una pareja de recién casados que descubren que además de amor también hay diferencias en el matrimonio, sin embargo, comienzan a vivir con ellas pretendiendo no darles importancia, pero la tensión comienza a subir de tono.

programme.title: La sombra del Caudillo
programme.desc: El Caudillo no se detiene ante nada en su búsqueda por el poder, valiéndose de la corrupción, la amenaza y el asesinato.

programme.title: El gran Makakikus
programme.desc: Un marqués arruinado pide la mano de una joven para aprovecharse de su familia, pero ella está enamorada de un charro.

programme.title: El Tejedor de Milagros
programme.desc: En Navidad, un indio llega a un pueblo con su esposa embarazada; pero como nadie los ayuda ella da a luz en plena calle.

programme.title: La mesera del café del puerto
programme.desc: Una mesera coja ayuda a un compositor que está en la ruina, logrando superarse y triunfar, luego ella se somete a una cirugía y deciden casarse.

programme.title: El Hombre Inquieto
programme.desc: Un vendedor de periódicos se hace pasar por el medio hermano de una joven, pero termina enamorándose de ella.

programme.title: Operación Tiburón
programme.desc: Un agente del gobierno es contratado para atrapar a un espía y su banda.

programme.title: El hombre que me gusta
programme.desc: Un matrimonio vive de parranda en parranda y acaban con su fortuna, como no consiguen un préstamo él piensa suicidarse.

programme.title: Sangre en el ruedo
programme.desc: Tras la muerte de su padre, un joven estudiante de Magisterio decide hacerse torero, y pronto triunfa como matador.

programme.title: Los Nietos de Don Venancio
programme.desc: Un hombre vuelve a España para un festejo familiar y se entera de que ha ocurrido un incendio en su tienda.

programme.title: Semáforo en Rojo
programme.desc: Un grupo de ladrones profesionales organizan el robo de una valiosa joya.

programme.title: El pequeño ruiseñor
programme.desc: Un pequeño monaguillo tiene una voz prodigiosa así que en complicidad con el sacristán canta en bodas y bautizos.

programme.title: Tu Recuerdo y Yo
programme.desc: La tragedia une a un trabajador y a una muchacha perteneciente a una familia minera arruinada.

programme.title: Vivir del cuento
programme.desc: Un empleado usa el nombre de su patrón para cometer fraude y es despedido, pero a su vez el patrón engaña a su ex-suegro.

programme.title: El beisbolista fenómeno
programme.desc: Un excelente beisbolista muere y supuestamente su espíritu entra en un vagabundo que empieza a jugar como todo un profesional.

programme.title: Extraña Cita
programme.desc: Una bella joven trata de vengarse de la muerte de su padre y sufre humillaciones mientras lo hace.

programme.title: Los tales por cuales
programme.desc: Un ranchero llega a un pueblo donde se atribuyen varios delitos al cacique y lo salva de varios atentados.

programme.title: La familia Pérez
programme.desc: Una familia, excesiva en sus pretensiones, aprende varias lecciones sobre humildad, amor y unión familiar.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: As summer marches on, Monty gets stuck into more seasonal jobs at Longmeadow. Adam Frost revels in the range of produce growing in a Victorian walled kitchen garden in Somerset.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Arit Anderson discovers a paradise garden in Cambridge which has become a focal point for the local community, and Frances Tophill shares the joy of collecting and saving heirloom vegetable seeds on a visit to Pembrokeshire.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond celebrate the horticultural genius of William Robinson in the gardens of his former home, Gravetye Manor in Sussex. Sue Kent gives her own garden some TLC.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Rachel de Thame and Arit Anderson explore the role gardeners can play in having a positive impact on wildlife in their gardens and communal green spaces. Nick Bailey meets an entomologist on a mission to change perceptions of common garden pests.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: With two little ones and a home renovation going on, Cardiff couple Nadine and Steve have paid little attention to their spacious garden. Can Charlie and the boys come up with design ideas that blend entertaining spaces and room for growing children?

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Music-loving couple Paul and Victoria welcome Charlie and the Rich Brothers to their retro-styled home in Coventry. With an original Anderson shelter in place and its owners bursting with imagination, this space is ready for a creative makeover.

programme.title: Garden Rescue
programme.desc: Charlie and the Rich Brothers meet Arvinder and Yolanda, a couple juggling older parents, twin babies and busy careers. Their garden has fallen into disrepair, so the team heads to south London to make a space where the family can stop and reflect.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost is in his garden, catching viewers up on his new patio project and discussing his plans for the autumn. Arit Anderson travels to Somerset to meet landscape designer Dan Pearson.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With autumn fast approaching, Monty is preparing the borders for the change of seasons and looking ahead to spring. Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit a glorious historic garden in North Yorkshire - Scampston Hall.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don has advice on how to successfully store an apple crop so it will last through winter and explains why he thinks it high time wall flowers came back into fashion. With tomatoes now over, Monty clears his greenhouse.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don is asked to rescue two nightmare outside spaces. In Salisbury, newly engaged Glenn and Zoe want a brand-new garden and most of all they are desperate to produce flowers for their wedding.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Oxford, two neighbours, Anne and Fliss are set on breaking down boundaries. They want to combine the front gardens of their semi-detached houses into one wonderful space filled with all their favourite grasses and perennials.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty helps two pairs of amateur gardeners who want to create dream gardens in very different urban spaces. In Bromley, Mei and Gerard have ambitious plans to turn their narrow, split-level garden into a Japanese paradise.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels to Europe and explores the influence of the Venetians on gardening. To begin with, he explores Venice on one of the city's barges, stepping out to visit green spaces large and small that are often hidden from view behind high walls.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins in the city of Trieste, close to Italy's border with Croatia, to visit a public garden first created by an obsessive royal plantsman more than 150 years ago, which is now being carefully restored.

programme.title: Monty Don's Adriatic Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins the last leg of his journey in Corfu, a Greek island with strong Venetian links, including olive trees planted by them that are still grown today. Here, Monty visits a spectacular garden made by an Englishman with Greek connections.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the middle of the country, from Wales to Norfolk. He comes across gardens for gnomes, much-loved, well-tended allotments and extravagant gardens that bankrupted their owners.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don explores the most densely populated part of the country, London and the home counties. He visits some of London's gardens, including a special one on a barge, as well as a beautifully restored garden close to where he grew up in Hampshire.

programme.title: Monty Don's British Gardens
programme.desc: Monty travels across the south-west of the country to visit some of Britain's most exotic gardens. On this journey, Monty also goes to some of the country's most historic gardens, as well as some challenging contemporary ones.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: After a short break, Monty's back at Longmeadow. With a change of seasons, he demonstrates how to prune summer fruiting raspberries, divides perennials and plants daffodils and hyacinths in containers.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants garlic, demonstrates how to divide crocosmia and sows ornamental grass seeds. Adam Frost visits Lowther Castle in the Lake District and finds out about its garden restoration project.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Adam Frost shares the progress that's been made in his garden. Frances Tophill heads to the beach to reveal what gardeners can learn from the coastal plants which have evolved to cope with more extreme conditions.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants mahonia for winter colour and scent, demonstrates how to take salvia cuttings and introduces a special addition to Longmeadow.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty starts work on revamping the writing garden, plants crocus bulbs and harvests pumpkins. Frances Tophill visits a unique plant conservation centre responsible for preserving key historical plants.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty plants a mix of white flowers in the writing garden, demonstrates how to prune a climbing rose and reviews what's been happening in the vegetable garden. Adam Frost celebrates seasonal colour on a visit to a garden in Essex.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty harvests his loofahs, plants tulip bulbs in pots, gives a masterclass in making leaf mould and reflects on the gardening year.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty shows how to stake dahlias, sows seeds of perennials and celebrates an abundant vegetable harvest. The team meet a landscape designer in Cornwall who creates gardens that are not only sustainable but also beautiful and edible.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: With Halloween approaching, Monty takes stock of his pumpkins and squashes, plants up alpines and shows how to divide a large fern to create new plants. Meanwhile, Adam Frost and Advolly Richmond visit Hever Castle in Kent.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty Don tackles some seasonal gardening jobs at Longmeadow and guest presenter Matthew Wilson has some ideas to brighten up a dark, north-facing wall.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: In Clapham, a young couple, Jack and Chris, want to turn their tiny urban backspace into a Victorian inspired plant collector's paradise with a high-tech twist.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Monty Don meets two sets of gardeners who are desperate for his help and advice to turn their outside spaces into dream gardens. In Worthing, Emma and Josh want to create a family garden for their little boy, Noah, who has Down Syndrome.

programme.title: Big Dreams, Small Spaces
programme.desc: Jennifer enlists the help of her sisters to create an Italian-themed garden in memory of their parents. She has great ideas and a budget to match, but growing citrus trees, olive trees and vines in a leafy London suburb is easier said than done.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty begins his journey in a prairie, the original American flowering wilderness. Much of the prairie has disappeared, but he meets a couple who have revived the tradition and enjoy showing it to him in full bloom.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty goes South to explore gardens of early independent America and learns how the history of this part of the country is still very much evident in the places and people he meets. He visits the famous garden of President Thomas Jefferson.

programme.title: Monty Don's American Gardens
programme.desc: Monty explores the scenery of the west coast of America. He begins his journey in Arizona where he learns about cacti and marvels at the sight of them in the desert and in private gardens where they have replaced traditional plants and lawns.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in and around Rome, a power base of emperors and popes, to explore gardens that are among some of the most extravagant and flamboyant ever created in history.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don visits gardens in Florence and the Tuscan countryside, discovering that renaissance gardens were created as works of art.

programme.title: Monty Don's Italian Gardens
programme.desc: Monty Don is in Naples visiting some of the most sublime, romantic retreats in southern Italy. After the formality of the green gardens around Rome and Florence, Monty seeks out idyllic horticultural gems set against the scenery of the Amalfi Coast.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
programme.desc: Monty and the team return with a celebration of spring. There's been plenty going on over the winter and lots of new projects in the garden to share. As well as getting on with some essential rose pruning, Monty plants clematis and rocket.

programme.title: Gardeners' World
